# Ship it & go live

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Testing
- What: Automated checks that prove each feature works, so a break is caught before users see it.
- Applies when: every app.
- Stage: day-one
- Kind: checkable
- Scope: cross-cutting
- Proof: test
- Done when: Every feature has tests for the normal case and at least one failure case, and the check command runs them all.

### Playwright
- What: Tests that use the app the way a person does, by clicking through it; Playwright is a common tool for this on the web.
- Applies when: the app has screens.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Scope: setup
- Proof: test
- Done when: At least one test drives the real app the way a person would, and the check command runs it. Each run starts its own copy of the app and never reuses one that is already running.

### CI/CD
- What: Run the checks automatically on every change, and release automatically when they pass.
- Applies when: the app is going live.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable

### Domain & DNS
- What: Your app's web address, and the settings that point it at your server.
- Applies when: the app is going live on the internet.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable
